name: dsh-tidewatch
description: A floating tide card for DeepSeek Harness: official peak/off-peak windows, the active tier, a live countdown to the next switch, and this session's API cost. Card copy follows the interface language (zh/en/ru) and the window table renders in the viewer's own time zone.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/pricing.js && node --check lib/client.js

dshhub.summary: A floating peak/off-peak tide card: official windows (UTC 01:00-04:00 / 06:00-10:00, shown in the viewer's time zone), a live phase dot, a countdown to the next switch, and this session's token breakdown with a locale-aware cost display. UI copy follows the DeepSeek Harness interface language (zh/en/ru).

author: Ivan Ashikhmin
